scope: Frozen current-candidate inference only; public synthetic numerical qualification.
what_this_adds: A public, cache-independent full-joint oracle and interface test entry point; not another rerun of saved scientific scoring.
important_non_bugs: Fixed-seed correlated draws need not permute samplewise with targets.
Target batches preserve marginal laws but separate calls do not preserve their between-batch sample coupling.
Exactly stored anchors return the existing observation, not a fresh replicate.
The public deployment weights are not the25 out-of-fold weights.
remaining_software_scope_limits: No arbitrary-resource or hostile-workload qualification; target count and draw count are caller-controlled.
No new certification of legacy training and baseline routines.
No claim of stable uniform JSON error objects for malformed calls; invalid inputs are rejected.
author_actions_needed_for_stronger_mater: New compatible independent material/batch evidence for transfer.
Reserved calibration units for coverage claims.
Real measured workflow resources for savings.
